configuration.text: Pair linkLabel with onLinkPress: the row leaves opening the document to the screen.
Set disabled to dim the row and stop the box changing; Read more still opens the text, so people can read what they agreed to.

configuration.text: children replaces the label and the link: when children is given, label and linkLabel are ignored, and the row's modes reach the children.
disableTruncation true turns off the Idle clamp: no ellipsis, and collapsedLines is ignored, so the label wraps in full.
The row forces its toggle Button to Button / Size XS, AppearanceBrand Secondary and Emphasis Low.

from.quote: The toggle Button's size, appearance, and emphasis are forced (XS, Secondary, Low).

examples.purpose: The required KYC consent before opening an account: the screen keeps the row's checked state and enables Open account only once the consent is ticked (shown unticked, so the Button is disabled).
examples.jsx:
<VStack>
  <ExpandableCheckbox
    label="I agree to share my KYC details with Jio Payments Bank to verify my identity and open this account."
    linkLabel="Terms"
    onLinkPress={() => {}}
    checked={false}
    onValueChange={() => {}}
  />
  <Button label="Open account" disabled onPress={() => {}} />
</VStack>

props.name: label
props.description: Primary label rendered next to the checkbox (Figma `Text` instance). Ignored when {@link children} is provided. Default "", from the component source.

props.name: linkLabel
props.description: Optional underlined link rendered after {@link label} (Figma `Link` instance, e.g. "Terms & Conditions"). Ignored when {@link children} is provided.

props.name: onLinkPress
props.description: Enter on the Terms link calls onLinkPress once and doesn't tick the box. Declared: Press handler for {@link linkLabel}. Navigation is left to the consumer.

props.name: children
props.description: Children wrap but are not clamped when Idle. Declared: Full label-slot override matching the Figma Checkbox Item `slot`. When provided, {@link label} / {@link linkLabel} are ignored and `modes` are cascaded into the slot children. Prefer this for fully custom label compositions.

props.name: defaultChecked
props.description: Initial checked state (uncontrolled). Default false, from the component source.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Space and Enter each tick or untick the box with one onValueChange per press, controlled or not, open or closed; the Terms link and Read more / Read less never tick it. Declared: Callback fired when the checked state changes.

props.name: expanded
props.description: Whether the row is expanded to reveal the full label (controlled).

props.name: defaultExpanded
props.description: Initial expanded state (uncontrolled). Defaults to `false` (Idle). Default false, from the component source.

props.name: onExpandedChange
props.description: Callback fired when the expanded state changes.

props.name: disabled
props.description: The row is exposed as disabled and can't be ticked, but Read more stays enabled and opens the text. Declared: Dims the row and blocks the checkbox and terms link. The disclosure toggle still opens so the consent can be read. Default false, from the component source.

props.name: readMoreLabel
props.description: A long toggle label squeezes the checkbox item: a 236 px button leaves the item 84 px and stacks the label and link. Declared: Label for the toggle button shown when the row is collapsed. Default "Read more", from the component source.

props.name: readLessLabel
props.description: Label for the toggle button shown when the row is expanded. Default "Read less", from the component source.

props.name: collapsedLines
props.description: Clamps the label only: the link is outside the clamp, so a long label puts the link on a second line (the Idle row is then 38 px tall). Declared: Number of lines to show when collapsed. Defaults to `1`. Default 1, from the component source.

props.name: disableTruncation
props.description: Wraps the label in full when Idle. Declared: When `true`, disables truncation of the collapsed label: the trailing ellipsis (`…`) is never shown and the `collapsedLines` clamp is ignored, so the label wraps fully even when horizontal space is tight. Default false, from the component source.

props.name: modes
props.description: Design token modes for theming (e.g. `{ 'Color Mode': 'Light' }`).

props.name: labelStyle
props.description: Override styles applied to the composed {@link label} `Text`. No-op when {@link children} is provided.

props.name: accessibilityLabel
props.description: Accessibility label for the checkbox. Falls back to `label`.

gaps.text: Figma's Expandable Checkbox has only two states, Idle and Open: checked, disabled, the number of collapsed lines and the toggle labels exist only in the package.
Still different from Figma: the label's line height is 17 in code (16 in Figma), and Read more is 84.9 px wide (81 in Figma).
